Spc

akhil_heads_401

This control chart shows fill weights from six filling heads (H1-H6) of one rotary filler, one colour and marker shape per head (see the legend), all sampled at the same times. The centre line and the 1, 2 and 3 sigma lines are labelled on the right; they apply to every head. Sample numbers are labelled every 10th sample, with one light gridline per sample. Apply these rules to each head separately, and only these: Rule 1: one sample beyond 3 sigma (above UCL or below LCL). The signal is at that sample. Rule 2: two of any three consecutive samples beyond 2 sigma on the same side of the centre line. The signal is at the later of those two samples. Rule 3: four of any five consecutive samples beyond 1 sigma on the same side of the centre line. The signal is at the fourth of those samples. Rule 4: eight consecutive samples on the same side of the centre line. The signal is at the eighth sample. A sample exactly on a line is not beyond it. Which head is the first to signal, and at which sample number? Answer in the form: head number, sample number (for example: 4, 37).
